name: Normal Estimation based on 4D Linear Regression
definition: A normal estimation scheme that integrates filtering and normal computation into one process to provide a smooth approximated gradient function, compensating for staircase artifacts caused by low sampling rates in shear-warp projection.
summary: Normal Estimation based on 4D Linear Regression estimates surface normals by fitting a linear function to a local voxel neighborhood, producing smooth gradients that reduce staircase artifacts in volume rendering.
